# Smartproxy

Smartproxy (now Decodo) offers a comprehensive suite of proxy and web scraping solutions, providing users with access to a vast network of residential, datacenter, ISP, and mobile proxies, along with scraping APIs for efficient data collection.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/smartproxy/.

## Actions

- **Get API Key** (read-only): Instruct how to obtain smartproxy api key.
- **List Endpoints and Ports** (read-only): Retrieve all available proxy endpoints and corresponding ports.
